hero.title: See the risk in every contract submission before you approve it.
hero.subtitle: Upload an invoice, timesheet, technical document or progress update. VERTEX returns a compliance score, a traffic light verdict and structured findings with clause references. In seconds.
hero.trust: Bilingual English and Arabic. Runs on your Supabase. UAE hosted.

features.title: Built for the review desk, not the sales deck.

items.title: Traffic light in seconds
items.body: A single glance tells you whether a submission passes, needs conditions, or should not ship. Green, amber, red. Backed by evidence.

items.title: Clause level findings
items.body: Every finding cites a contract clause, quotes the exact evidence and states the confidence. No hallucination without a citation.

items.title: Bilingual by design
items.body: Full Arabic and English. Right to left flips correctly, dates and currency respect the locale. No half translations.

items.title: Full audit trail
items.body: Every upload, analysis, comment and approval is written to an immutable audit log. Show it to auditors, save the argument.

items.title: Your keys, your data
items.body: AI keys stay in Supabase secrets. Files live in a private storage bucket protected by row level security. The browser never sees a key.

items.title: Installable app
items.body: Install VERTEX on Android from your browser. Standalone window, splash screen, offline shell. No app store required.

steps.title: Upload the document
steps.body: Pick the project, pick the type, drop the file. Twenty five megabytes, most common formats. Signed URLs only.

steps.title: VERTEX analyzes
steps.body: The AI provider you configured extracts findings against the contract terms, scores compliance and picks a traffic light.

steps.title: You approve or push back
steps.body: Reviewers approve, add conditions or reject with an audit log entry. Comments thread stays with the submission for good.

install.title: Get the Android app
install.subtitle: Install VERTEX to your home screen as a standalone app. Same product, same account, faster launch.
install.iosNote: On iPhone or iPad, open in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
